name: cli-agent-mcp
description: Delegate coding and ops tasks to a local headless CLI agent (Kimi Code, Claude Code or Cursor) and watch it work. With love by Bytars and the community.
long_description:
Runs a headless CLI coding agent on this machine as a background worker for Claude: it inherits this machine's environment (VPN routes, SSH agent, credentials), streams live progress, and can be asked for a plan before it executes anything. Installed as an extension, Claude Desktop launches it and passes the settings below; there is nothing to pair. Read the Security model section of the README before pointing it at anything you care about: https://github.com/Bytars/cli-agent-mcp#security-model

With love by Bytars (https://www.bytars.com) and the community. Open source under Apache-2.0: every issue, idea and pull request makes it better — https://github.com/Bytars/cli-agent-mcp

default_agent.title: Default agent
default_agent.description: Agent used when a task does not name one: kimi, claude, cursor or custom.

kimi_bin.title: Kimi Code CLI
kimi_bin.description: Launcher for Kimi Code. Leave as 'kimi' if it is on PATH, or give the full path, e.g. C:\Users\you\.kimi-code\bin\kimi.exe.

claude_bin.title: Claude Code CLI
claude_bin.description: Launcher for Claude Code. Leave as 'claude' if it is on PATH.

default_cwd.title: Default working directory
default_cwd.description: Where a task runs when it does not name a directory. Empty means the directory Claude Desktop starts the server in.

allowed_cwds.title: Allowed directories (recommended)
allowed_cwds.description: Roots a task may run in, separated by ';'. A task asking for anything outside them is refused. Empty means any directory — the worker inherits your whole environment, so set this.

disallowed_tools.title: Denied tools (Claude Code)
disallowed_tools.description: Claude Code --disallowedTools, the real deny list, e.g. Bash(rm:*),Bash(git push:*). Kimi Code has no equivalent flag: it runs its tool calls without asking.

permission_mode.title: Claude Code permission mode
permission_mode.description: acceptEdits (default), auto, plan, manual, dontAsk or bypassPermissions.
